name: Calamity Beasts
description: The Calamity Beasts are fearsome natural-disaster creatures of Bloomburrow, heralds of seasonal and chaotic change, such as the Blight Snake, Drought Cat and Spring Elk.

pages_say.description: Fearsome heralds of nature's changes, seasonal and chaotic.
Fearsome heralds of seasonal and chaotic change, kept away from Valley since the weavers' great weavings.
Natural-disaster beasts that Glarb wishes to command.
